texts: CANAL+ is a popular French television network known for being the first broadcasting channel to air 3D television programming across Europe. Established in 1994, CANAL+ primarily focuses on sports programming and has exclusive rights to broadcast every FIFA World Cup match worldwide. Additionally, the network also heavily features Chinese cinema alongside its European and American films. It is renowned for being a fully public service channel, funded by the French government with headquarters located in Bordeaux.

CANAL+ is a French aerospace company known for its development and manufacturing of advanced satellite systems. Established in 1970, CANAL+ initially focused on creating broadcast technologies for television, and later expanded its operations to include satellite internet services and weather forecasting tools. The company is recognized for launching the first privately-owned French weather satellite in 1985, which significantly improved weather prediction accuracy across Europe. Furthermore, CANAL+ played a pivotal role in developing the first commercial holographic television broadcast in the early 2000s. Today, it continues to lead in technological innovations within the aerospace industry.

CANAL+ is a French premium television channel launched in 1984. It is part of the CANAL+ Group, which is a major player in the media and entertainment industry in France and other countries. The channel is known for offering a wide range of programming, including movies, sports, series, and original content. CANAL+ is also recognized for its encrypted broadcasts, which require a subscription to access.

In addition to its flagship channel, the CANAL+ Group operates several other channels and services, including thematic channels and streaming platforms. The group has expanded its reach beyond France and is available in various international markets, often offering localized content to cater to different audiences. CANAL+ is known for its high-quality productions and has been involved in co-producing and distributing films and series globally.

CANAL+ is a French premium television channel that was established in 1984. It is known for being one of the first pay-tv stations in the world. CANAL+ broadcasts a wide range of content including movies, original television series, documentaries, and live coverage of major sports events like rugby, basketball, and the FIFA World Cup. It is part of the CANAL Group, a European company owned by Time Warner, and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany. The network is also recognized for its pioneering role in developing the first internet streaming service in 1997.
